description: The R installation manager: Install, remove, configure R versions.
notes: rig defaults to admin mode, which installs R system-wide under 'C:\Program Files\R' and needs UAC.
To keep R in your user profile instead (no admin rights needed), finish the setup with:
In user mode rig adds '%USERPROFILE%\.local\bin' (the R/Rscript quick links) to your user PATH;
open a new terminal afterwards. On an existing admin-mode setup 'rig system user-mode' migrates
your R versions; see 'rig system user-mode --help'.
While rig is in admin mode, installing or updating rig adds 'C:\Program Files\R\bin' to your
user PATH. After switching to user mode, remove that entry so it cannot shadow the user-mode links.
Update rig with 'scoop update rig'; 'rig self update' does not work for Scoop installs.
If you ran 'rig system script-assoc' before rig.exe moved to the 'bin' folder, run it again
so that .R files open with the new path.
